scripts.dev: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.build: cargo build && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:app && npm run build --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.test: npm run build && node --test tests/*.test.cjs; status=$?; node tests/reap.cjs; exit $status
scripts.package: cargo build --release && npm run build:sdk && npm run typecheck:app && npm run package --workspace wangcai-desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace @wangcai/sdk && npm run typecheck:app
scripts.typecheck:app: npm run typecheck --workspace wangcai-desktop && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/terminal-agent && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/files && npm run typecheck --prefix plugins/terminal
scripts.test:package: npm run package && node --test tests/package.cjs; status=$?; node tests/reap.cjs; exit $status
